## Something Different

Your wounds close a little too fast. You never catch a cold. Somewhere, before you were born, someone in a laboratory decided what you would become, and then let you forget.

You are a Hidden Modified Human. Nothing shows yet.

**Prerequisites (all of)** — [Human Will](r_human.md#q-7dde06c5219ec293)

**Tasks**

- Be a Hidden Modified Human

**Rewards**

- Doriki +90, Belly +2,000, +2 Training Points (your race)

<a id="q-19b92d29817aacfb"></a>

## The Body Wakes

It comes all at once: skin that turns a blade, a body that heals overnight, the strength the Vinsmoke children were built with. Unlike them, you keep your heart.

Play twenty hours and reach 5,000 Doriki: then the modification wakes up, and you have the modified humans' body, Raid Suit and techniques.

**Prerequisites (all of)** — [Something Different](r_human.md#q-5f36f002a80d8ee3)

**Tasks**

- Hours played as a Hidden Modified Human
- Reach 5,000 Doriki
- Wake the modification

**Rewards**

- Doriki +210, Belly +8,500, +4 Training Points (your race)

<a id="q-348d5d37f97dfaa7"></a>

## Germa 66

Germa's soldiers carry their armour in a tin no bigger than a lunch box. Only a modified body can open it.

Carry a Germa 66 Ration Box. Use it to put a Raid Suit on or take it off; sneak and use it to pick a suit.

**Prerequisites (any of)** — [The Body Wakes](r_human.md#q-19b92d29817aacfb), [Born of Germa](r_human.md#q-348d5d37f97dfaa7)

**Tasks**

- Carry a Germa 66 Ration Box

**Rewards**

- Doriki +210, Belly +8,500, +4 Training Points (your race)

## Germa's Soldier

The Vinsmoke children each wear one colour. A soldier who can wear any of them is worth the whole family.

Reach 25,000 Doriki in a Raid Suit of your choice.

- Wear a Raid Suit

**Rewards**
